summary: Verified BridgeBot 'Reset Scripted Counters' feature end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass for GET/POST /api/discord/scripted-counters/{count,reset} — auth gating, X-Instance-ID requirement, per-instance scoping, idempotent reset, scripted_skips analytics preserved on reset, other-instance counters untouched. Frontend (route is actually /admin/discord, NOT /admin/discord-bot as in the request): logged in as administrator, selected 'Scripted Test' workspace, enabled Scripted Mode, verified the 'Active user counters' card shows 0 with Reset button disabled, seeded 2 counters in DB, the 5s setInterval poll picked up the change within ~2s, badge showed 2 with button enabled, clicked Reset (window.confirm auto-accepted), toast 'Reset 2 user counter(s). The next message will get the Primary reply.' appeared, badge returned to 0, button disabled again, DB collection verified empty.
critical_code_review_comments: The frontend route is /admin/discord (App.js line 72: `<Route path="discord" />`) — the review_request referenced /admin/discord-bot which does not exist. If main agent intends to rename, also update sidebar 'Discord Channel' link target. Non-blocking — page works fine at the real path.

DiscordSettings.js is 1227 lines (above the 700-line soft cap noted in iteration_10). Strongly recommend splitting Scripted Mode block, Human Takeover block, and ChannelGroup into separate files for maintainability.

loadStatus() in DiscordSettings.js fires 3 unconditional GETs every 5s (/discord/status, /discord/handoff-status, /discord/scripted-counters/count) regardless of whether Scripted Mode is enabled. Consider gating the scripted-counters poll on `scripted.enabled` to save bandwidth/server cycles when feature is off.

The backend `get_scripted_counters_count` swallows ALL exceptions on scripted_skips lookup with bare `except Exception: pass` (server.py ~L2242). This is fine for resilience but masks misconfig — consider logger.debug there.
updated_files: /tmp/seed_counters.py (test helper for direct DB seeding used by Playwright run)
seed_data_creation: 11 pytest cases seed TEST_ prefixed scripted_counters docs and clean them up via fixture teardown. UI test seeded 2 TEST_uitest_* docs in scripted_counters for instance 8292460c…, which were cleared both by the UI's Reset Counters button and by post-test cleanup. No residual TEST_ data left in DB.

rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as designed. Both new endpoints respect per-instance scoping via Depends(get_instance_access), only delete from scripted_counters (not scripted_skips), and the frontend polls every 5s so manual DB inserts surface in the UI within one poll cycle. window.confirm flow + toast + state update + button disable all chain correctly.
